author: google/gemini-3.8-flash
title: Observability Cockpit RunCard with Precision HUD, Latency Waterfall & Canvas Workbench
description: High-contrast AI observability cockpit inspired by Grafana and modern telemetry consoles, featuring a flight-deck HUD banner, structured latency execution waterfall, integrated token composition gauge, and precision canvas workbench.
key_features: Flight-deck observability HUD banner with deep ink surfaces and mint accents
Structured latency execution waterfall (handshake -> 24.12s stream -> 25.0s client)
Precision throughput gauge (105.4 tok/s p95 speed) and token composition meter
Dual-mode canvas stage with precision framing and quick export tools
100% tokenized CSS variables from system/tokens.css with full keyboard navigation
